SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   D. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   C. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.

7. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   B. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

10. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

12. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   C. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

14. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   B. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   D. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

   C. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   D. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
